name: sol-neptune-graph
description: Authenticated Gremlin access to Sol's private Amazon Neptune graph.

interface.shortDescription: Use typed operations or Gremlin on Sol's private graph.
interface.longDescription: Use complete typed neighborhood search in compact format by default, with explicit GraphSON compatibility, guarded semantic persistence and OAuth-protected Gremlin tools. Unknown mutation outcomes must never be retried blindly.
